obh-soru-aynali.soru: By what name is Orhan Bey Bath known today?
ipuclari: Look at the writing above the entrance in the photograph.
obh-soru-aynali.dogru_metin: Before the 1958 Bazaar fire, the bath's men's section was known as the Aynalı Bazaar; the building is now known as the Old Aynalı Bazaar.
obh-soru-aynali.yanlis_metin: Try again. You can ask for a hint below.

obh-saha-giris.gorev: Find one of the entrances marked "Eski Aynalı Çarşı".
obh-saha-giris.yerinde: Go up to the entrance and tap "I'm here".
obh-saha-giris.evden: Tap the bath's entrance in the 3D model.
obh-saha-giris.tamam_metin: The building has three entrances: north, south and west. According to the inventory the northern one is original and the others were opened later.

obh-hikaye.ad: You listened to Orhan Bey Bath
obh-hikaye.metin: You listened to or read the story of Orhan Bey Bath to the end.

obh-aynali.metin: You learned the name by which the bath is known as a bazaar today.

obh-uc-giris.metin: You found the entrance of the Old Aynalı Bazaar.
